ratings_why.fun: Placing climbers behind the right carry is a real puzzle from Tier 4 on, but the first turns barely grow because half of a +1/+1 rounds to nothing.
ratings_why.distinct: A tribe that multiplies another tribe's carry and gives the back row a job plays unlike any of today's six tribes.

verdict_why: Viscum's timing needs one clear sentence and the early rise needs a floor; after that, more passes would only make it different.

points.text: Say when The Honourable Viscum Highbough rises: at once in the fight when Cousin Dodder takes, or at End of Turn with everything else. The core rule says End of Turn; his text reads like every gain, at once.
Woodbine's +3/+3 for a new host is free to earn by moving it between two back slots every turn, so swapping is always right. Reward a host it has never climbed before, or a host of a new tribe.
Give rising a floor of +1/+1 when the host gained anything, so Tier 1 to 3 climbers visibly rise in rounds 2 to 5 instead of standing still.
Young Ivy is a 1/2 that does nothing early. A small fight effect, such as giving its host +1 Health at Start of Combat, would let it hold a slot until it turns adult.

standouts.why: Copies every gain in full but loses his host if he becomes the biggest, so you have to keep feeding the carry: a self-limit that is also a puzzle.
Moving Lady Hedera behind a new tribe each turn makes a mixed board pay off, and the payoff grows to +10/+10 on every host.
Apple Mistletoe moves the carry's Attack into the safe back row and makes the host tankier, a fresh way to use both rows.

weakest.why: A tiny body with no early effect; all its value comes turns later.
Ivy Bush's +1/+1 per climber is slow and caps at three climbers before Ivy-clad Ruin.
Hop Bine gives at most one gold a turn and takes one of the three back slots climbers fight over.

flags.note: Cousin Dodder keeps a quarter of the biggest enemy's stats on every attack, permanently, so it grows with the lobby's best board each fight; with Viscum climbing it, both grow.
Whether Viscum rises during the fight or at End of Turn is not said.
Barley-Sugar Twiner's repeated gain counts as a new permanent gain, so a golden Twiner with Viscum on the same host quadruples one big Ooze meal.
